'''Feral Wolves''' are the [[:Category:Feral_Parasites|Feral Version]] of Wolves.

==''Spawning''==

* Spawned when a Wolf is killed by a [[Gnat]] or [[Lice]].
* Spawns from a Wolf succumbing to [[Call Of The Hive]] at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onwards.
* Spawns when an [[Assimilated Wolf]] accumulates a killcount of 60 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 6, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] onwards, with a spawnweight of 25, once 3 Wolves have been assimilated.

==''Behavior''==
Feral Wolves are Melee Combatants.

* Feral Wolves attack through contact damage.
* Feral Wolves can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Feral Wolves are able to sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On hit Feral Wolfs has a chance to drop [[Remains|Feral Remains]].

===''Weaknesses''===
*Feral Wolves, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Feral Wolves have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Feral Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
* On death, Feral Wolves have a chance to drop a [[Gnat]].
